subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Bottom line
solution:
The correct answer is "**The most important fact**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The meaning of the given idiom is "**the final result or the most important consideration of a situation, activity, or discussion".**
 
• We use the given idiom to refer to a situation where we are highlighting an important fact or point.
 
 
• **Example**: *Zidane said, "The **bottom line**__ is we cannot lose to our arch rivals in the final in front of our fans."*
 
 

​Hence, the correct answer is **option 3.**
